## About
Rohan Anil Bondre is a Computer Engineering Graduate from Indira College of Engineering and Management, Pune (Savitribai Phule Pune University), with a strong interest in Operating Systems, System Design, Networking, Artificial Intelligence, and Cybersecurity.

## API & Markdown Negotiation
This site fully supports `Accept: text/markdown` content negotiation. AI agents can request any HTML page route with the `Accept: text/markdown` header to receive a clean, token-efficient markdown version of the content, skipping the Next.js app shell and UI components.

## Technical Stack
This portfolio is built with:
- Next.js (App Router)
- React 19
- TailwindCSS (v4)
- Bun
